original_benchmark.notes: PRBench Finance (Scale AI, arXiv 2511.11562): expert-written conversations graded against weighted rubric criteria by an LLM judge (o4-mini in the paper). finance_hard (300) is a subset of these records.
PRBench Legal. legal_hard (250) is a subset of these records.

harbor_adapter.notes: Oracle and nop runs cover all 1100 tasks: on Harbor 0.27.0 at this revision, where ORACLE_MODE=true gives reward 1.0 only to the reply of solution/solve.sh (checked by sha256), and on Harbor 0.26.0 at the parity revision. Parity on a 200-task subset (--split parity), 100 per domain, stratified by hard-subset membership and topic: two runs per side, run ranges overlap on both domains and overall, paired per-task difference +0.0002 +/- 0.0059 (SE). parity_costs is an upper bound for the two runs (the endpoint's total usage over the two runs).
